## Budgets

**Sizing.** A visual plan of 2 to 12 images (up to 24 in its largest first copy, about 500 KB each), copied 1 to 4 times, with up to 3 managers finishing plans at once on one shared board token.

**At 10×.** At 10 concurrent first copies, GitHub's secondary rate limiter refuses copies; accepted past 3 at once, which is budgeted.

**Added budgets:**

| Budget | Target |
| --- | --- |
| [GitHub requests per new image][1] | ≤2 requests |
| [GitHub requests per unchanged image][2] | ≤0 requests |
| [GitHub copy time for a 24-image plan][3] | ≤60 seconds |
| [GitHub copies refused, 3 at once][4] | ≤0 copies |
| [Slowest of 3 concurrent GitHub copies][5] | ≤240 seconds |

[1]: https://github.com/nickderobertis/onetaskgraph/issues/3304#budget-github-asset-requests-per-new-asset
[2]: https://github.com/nickderobertis/onetaskgraph/issues/3304#budget-github-asset-requests-per-unchanged-asset
[3]: https://github.com/nickderobertis/onetaskgraph/issues/3304#budget-github-asset-copy-seconds
[4]: https://github.com/nickderobertis/onetaskgraph/issues/3304#budget-github-concurrent-copies-refused
[5]: https://github.com/nickderobertis/onetaskgraph/issues/3304#budget-github-concurrent-copy-seconds

<details>
<summary>4 budgets changed for other reasons</summary>

- [Linear requests per new image](https://github.com/nickderobertis/onetaskgraph/issues/3305#budget-linear-asset-requests-per-new-asset): measure, command
- [Linear requests per unchanged image](https://github.com/nickderobertis/onetaskgraph/issues/3305#budget-linear-asset-requests-per-unchanged-asset): measure, command
- [Linear copy time for a 24-image plan](https://github.com/nickderobertis/onetaskgraph/issues/3305#budget-linear-asset-copy-seconds): measure, command
- [Linear copies refused, 3 at once](https://github.com/nickderobertis/onetaskgraph/issues/3305#budget-linear-concurrent-copies-refused): measure, command

</details>

**Check runtime added:** ≈10 s, not estimated for GitHub requests per new image; GitHub requests per unchanged image; GitHub copy time for a 24-image plan; GitHub copies refused, 3 at once; Slowest of 3 concurrent GitHub copies.

**Not budgeted:**

- how the work scales with data: Requests grow linearly per image and each is budgeted; image size is capped by each destination.
- spend: Accepted exception: the one new dispatch, `spike-visual`, is capped at 40 turns.
- latency (the visual spike delays the design document): Accepted exception: the spike delays the document by at most its 40-turn cap.
- resource use: At most about 12 MB of images per plan, in the gitignored authoring root.
- image retention: Existing authoring storage keeps assets; no retention or deletion policy is added.
- upload bandwidth: Largest copies upload 12 MB on existing transports, without bandwidth control.
